kind: Bug triage: four bugs, one fixed by its author, a duplicate, a deferral, and an unreproducible report

turns.speaker: priya
turns.text: Thanks for joining, both of you. Sam, I hear some echo. Are you on speaker?

turns.speaker: sam
turns.text: Sorry, switching to headphones. Is that better?

turns.speaker: priya
turns.text: Much better, thanks.

turns.speaker: priya
turns.text: Let's go through the new bugs. There are four. First one, bug 212: the game crashes on launch on iPads running iOS 17.

turns.speaker: sam
turns.text: I saw that one. It's every iPad on 17, not just some of them.

turns.speaker: priya
turns.text: I can reproduce it. It's the new audio session code I wrote last week. It asks for a mode that iOS 17 doesn't support on iPad. It's my code, so I'll fix it.

turns.speaker: ben
turns.text: That's a launch crash, so it shouldn't wait for 1.5. Can we do a hotfix?

turns.speaker: priya
turns.text: Yes. Let's ship a 1.4.1 hotfix on Friday with just that fix.

turns.speaker: sam
turns.text: Agreed, Friday.

turns.speaker: priya
turns.text: Next, bug 215: the leaderboard shows the wrong names for players with emoji in their names.

turns.speaker: ben
turns.text: That's a duplicate of 198. Sam already fixed it on the main branch, and it goes out with 1.5.

turns.speaker: sam
turns.text: Right, that one's fixed.

turns.speaker: priya
turns.text: Then I'm closing 215 as a duplicate. Done. Bug 219: the music keeps playing after you quit to the menu on Android.

turns.speaker: sam
turns.text: It's annoying, but harmless. I don't think it's worth fixing before 1.5.

turns.speaker: ben
turns.text: Agreed, let's leave it for 1.5.

turns.speaker: priya
turns.text: OK, 219 waits for 1.5. Last one, bug 220, and this one worries me. Three players say they lost coins right after a purchase.

turns.speaker: ben
turns.text: We can't reproduce it. I tried on four devices yesterday, and the coins were always there.

turns.speaker: sam
turns.text: I'm on call this week, so I'll pull the purchase logs for those three players and see what the store says.

turns.speaker: priya
turns.text: Thanks, Sam. Ben, could you reply to the three players and tell them we're looking into it? They've been waiting for two days.

turns.speaker: ben
turns.text: Sure, I'll write to them today.

turns.speaker: priya
turns.text: And we should have a test that restores purchases after a reinstall. We never test that path. I don't want to give it to anyone yet, let's just add it to the backlog.

turns.speaker: sam
turns.text: Makes sense.

turns.speaker: priya
turns.text: OK, that's all four. Thanks, both of you.

decisions.text: Ship a 1.4.1 hotfix on Friday with only the iPad launch crash fix.
Bug 215 is closed as a duplicate of 198, already fixed on main for 1.5.
Bug 219 (music keeps playing on Android) waits for 1.5.

tasks.title: Fix the iOS 17 launch crash on iPad (bug 212)
Pull the purchase logs for the three players who lost coins (bug 220)
Reply to the three players who lost coins
Add a test that restores purchases after a reinstall (backlog)

truth.notes: The restore test was explicitly left without an owner. Priya closed 215 during the call, so there is nothing left to do on it.
